title: 스마트도시 조성 및 산업진흥 등에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport ( Urban Economy Division ), 044-201-3737, 3738, 4878, 4879

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「스마트도시 조성 및 산업진흥 등에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Creation of Smart Cities and the Promotion of Industry, etc. and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(국가시범도시건설사업에 대한 성과평가계획의 수립 등) ① 국토교통부장관은 「스마트도시 조성 및 산업진흥 등에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제35조의3제2항에 따른 국가시범도시건설사업에 대한 성과평가를 위한 계획(이하 “성과평가계획”이라 한다)을 매년 수립해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Establishment of Performance Evaluation Plan for National Pilot City Construction Projects, etc.) ① The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall establish a plan for the performance evaluation of national pilot city construction projects pursuant to Article 35-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act on the Creation and Promotion of Smart Cities and Industries, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) every year (hereinafter referred to as the “performance evaluation plan”).

rows.source_ko: ② 성과평가계획에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The performance evaluation plan must include the following items:
1. Basic Direction and Implementation Schedule for Performance Evaluation
2. Scope and Subjects of Performance Evaluation

rows.source_ko: 3. 성과평가의 기준, 성과지표 및 성과지표별 배점
rows.text_en: 3. Performance Evaluation Criteria, Performance Indicators, and Scoring per Performance Indicator
4. Preparation of materials necessary for performance evaluation
5. Plan for Utilizing Performance Evaluation Results

rows.source_ko: 6. 성과평가 결과의 공개 대상 범위 및 방법
rows.text_en: 6. Scope and Method of Disclosure of Performance Evaluation Results

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 국가시범도시건설사업의 성과를 객관적으로 평가하기 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters deemed necessary to objectively evaluate the performance of the National Pilot City Construction Project

rows.source_ko: ③ 국토교통부장관은 성과평가계획을 수립하면 이를 지체 없이 해당 국가시범도시건설사업의 사업시행자에게 통보해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport establishes a performance evaluation plan, he/she shall notify the project implementer of the relevant national pilot city construction project without delay.
[This Article Newly Inserted Oct. 6, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(국가시범도시건설사업에 대한 성과평가의 실시) ① 국토교통부장관은 제3조의3에 따른 성과평가위원회의 심의를 거쳐 국가시범도시건설사업의 성과를 평가하고, 그 결과를 사업시행자에게 통보해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Implementation of Performance Evaluation for National Pilot City Construction Projects) ① The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall evaluate the performance of national pilot city construction projects through deliberation by the Performance Evaluation Committee pursuant to Article 3-3 and notify the project implementer of the results.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 통보를 받은 사업시행자는 그 결과에 이의가 있는 경우에는 통보를 받은 날부터 10일 이내에 이의신청 내용과 관련 소명자료를 국토교통부장관에게 제출할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② If a project implementer who has received the notification pursuant to Paragraph 1 has an objection to the result, they may submit the details of the objection and related explanatory materials to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport within 10 days from the date of receiving the notification.

rows.source_ko: ③ 국토교통부장관은 제2항에 따른 이의신청이 있는 경우 성과평가위원회의 재심의를 거쳐 이의신청 내용의 반영여부를 확정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In the event of an objection filed pursuant to Paragraph 2, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall determine whether to reflect the contents of the objection after re-examination by the Performance Evaluation Committee.
[This Article Newly Inserted Oct. 6, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(국가시범도시건설사업에 대한 성과평가 결과의 공개 등) ① 국토교통부장관은 제3조제1항에 따른 성과평가 결과를 매년 3월 31일까지 국토교통부 인터넷 홈페이지에 공개해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Disclosure of Performance Evaluation Results for National Pilot City Construction Projects, etc.) ① The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall disclose the results of the performance evaluation pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1 on the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport’s website by March 31 of each year.

rows.source_ko: ② 국토교통부장관은 제3조제1항에 따라 실시한 성과평가 결과를 법 제36조에 따른 국가시범도시에 대한 지원을 위한 자료로 활용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may use the results of the performance evaluation conducted pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1 as data for supporting national pilot cities pursuant to Article 36 of the Act .
[This Article Newly Inserted Oct. 6, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의3(국가시범도시건설사업 성과평가위원회의 구성ㆍ운영 등) ① 국토교통부장관은 법 제35조의3제2항에 따라 국가시범도시건설사업에 대한 성과를 평가하기 위하여 성과평가위원회(이하 “성과평가위원회”라 한다)를 구성ㆍ운영한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3-3 (Composition and Operation of the Performance Evaluation Committee for National Pilot City Construction Projects, etc.) ① The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall constitute and operate a Performance Evaluation Committee (hereinafter referred to as the “Performance Evaluation Committee”) to evaluate the performance of national pilot city construction projects pursuant to Article 35-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: ② 성과평가위원회는 법 제23조제4항에 따른 전문위원회 위원 중 국토교통부장관이 임명 또는 위촉하는 사람으로 구성한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Performance Evaluation Committee shall be composed of persons appointed or commissioned by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport from among the members of the expert committee pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 4 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: ③ 성과평가위원회 위원장은 제2항에 따른 위원 중에서 국토교통부장관이 임명 또는 위촉하는 사람으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The chairperson of the Performance Evaluation Committee shall be a person appointed or commissioned by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport from among the members pursuant to Paragraph 2.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 성과평가위원회의 구성 및 운영에 필요한 세부사항은 국토교통부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall determine the detailed matters necessary for the composition and operation of the Performance Evaluation Committee .
[This Article Newly Inserted Oct. 6, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(스마트혁신사업 및 스마트실증사업 신청서 등) ① 「스마트도시 조성 및 산업진흥 등에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제52조제2항에 따른 스마트혁신사업 신청서는 별지 제3호서식에 따르고, 영 제53조에 따라 영 제52조제2항이 준용되는 스마트실증사업의 경우에는 별지 제4호서식에 따른다. <개정 2021. 7. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Applications for Smart Innovation Projects and Smart Demonstration Projects, etc.) ① The application for a smart innovation project pursuant to Article 52, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Creation of Smart Cities and the Promotion of Smart Industries, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Appendix; in the case of a smart demonstration project to which Article 52, Paragraph 2 of the Decree applies mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 53 of the Decree, the application shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Appendix. <Amended July 12, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제52조제6항에 따른 스마트혁신사업계획 승인 확인서(영 제53조에 따라 준용되는 스마트실증사업계획 승인 확인서를 포함한다)는 별지 제5호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The certificate of approval for a smart innovation project plan pursuant to Article 52, Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree ( including the certificate of approval for a smart demonstration project plan applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 53 of the Enforcement Decree) shall be in accordance with Form No. 5 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제4조의2(규제신속확인 신청서 등) ① 영 제52조의2제1항에 따른 규제신속확인 신청서는 별지 제5호의2서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 4-2 (Application for Expedited Confirmation of Regulations, etc.) ①The application for expedited confirmation of regulations pursuant to Article 52-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 5-2 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제52조의2제2항에 따른 규제신속확인 결과 통지서는 별지 제5호의3서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The notification of the result of the expedited regulatory verification pursuant to Article 52-2, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 5-3 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted July 12, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(스마트혁신사업계획 및 스마트실증사업계획 연장신청서 및 연장확인서) ① 영 제54조제3항에 따른 스마트혁신사업계획 연장신청서(영 제53조에 따라 준용되는 스마트실증사업계획 연장신청서를 포함한다)는 별지 제6호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Application for Extension of Smart Innovation Project Plan and Smart Demonstration Project Plan and Confirmation of Extension) ①The application for extension of the Smart Innovation Project Plan pursuant to Article 54, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree ( including the application for extension of the Smart Demonstration Project Plan applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 53 of the Enforcement Decree) shall be in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제54조제4항에 따른 스마트혁신사업계획 연장확인서(영 제53조에 따라 준용되는 스마트실증사업계획 연장확인서를 포함한다)는 별지 제7호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The confirmation of extension of the smart innovation project plan pursuant to Article 54, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree ( including the confirmation of extension of the smart demonstration project plan applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 53 of the Enforcement Decree) shall be in accordance with Form No. 7 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제6조(법령정비 요청서 등) ① 영 제58조의3제3항에 따른 법령정비 요청서는 별지 제8호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Request for Amendment of Laws and Regulations, etc.) ①The request for amendment of laws and regulations pursuant to Article 58-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 8 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제58조의3제4항에 따른 법령정비 요청 확인서는 별지 제9호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The confirmation form for the request for revision of laws and regulations pursuant to Article 58-3, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 9 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제58조의3제7항에 따른 법령정비 검토 결과서는 별지 제10호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ③ The report on the results of the review of legal reform pursuant to Article 58-3, Paragraph 7 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 10 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted July 12, 2021]
